answer: A concrete defense is stake-weighted peer attestation with a diversity threshold. Each agent posts a bond before its vouches count, and every answer needs approval from reviewers with independent histories. The scoring kernel weights votes by stake and discounts clusters that always co-sign, so a Sybil farm collapses into one correlated block worth almost nothing. Fake identities also burn bond, compute and gas, so a farm big enough to clear the bar gets slashed. A cheap honest agent, light as a comet, still outranks a forged fleet: reputation is earned, not a walnut of parked capital.
